# DataCite 4.3 JSON Schema

A test fixture: the DataCite export is validated against it. Nothing at run time reads it.

- **File:** `datacite_4.3_schema.json`, unchanged.
- **Source:** <https://github.com/datacite/schema/blob/591a9cc86eb7989782dde1b49bbc6f5531b71f34/source/json/kernel-4.3/datacite_4.3_schema.json>
- **Repository and commit:** `datacite/schema` at `591a9cc86eb7989782dde1b49bbc6f5531b71f34`
  (`master`, fetched 2026-11-13). 4.3 is the newest JSON Schema the repository holds.
- **Licence:** the repository carries no licence file. Its `source/json/README.md` says the
  JSON schemas were contributed by Invenio and are "not an official DataCite metadata schema";
  the official schema is the XML one under `source/meta`.
